dependencies.name: @axe-core/playwright
dependencies.necessity: Runs axe accessibility assertions inside the Playwright smoke suite required by the testing strategy.
dependencies.maintenance: Maintained by Deque Labs alongside axe-core with regular releases.
dependencies.notes: MPL-2.0 is file-level copyleft. Accepted for development scope only because the package never ships in a runtime image.

dependencies.name: @eslint/js
dependencies.necessity: Supplies the recommended ESLint rule set consumed by the flat config.
dependencies.maintenance: Published by the ESLint team in lockstep with eslint.

dependencies.name: @playwright/test
dependencies.necessity: Runs the desktop and mobile browser accessibility smoke suite against the production build.
dependencies.maintenance: Maintained by Microsoft on a predictable release train.

dependencies.name: @prisma/adapter-pg
dependencies.necessity: Drives Prisma over the node-postgres pool so the application and the queue share one connection strategy.
dependencies.maintenance: Released with the Prisma core version and pinned to the same version as @prisma/client.

dependencies.name: @prisma/client
dependencies.necessity: Provides the typed data access layer and migration-compatible client for all workspace-scoped queries.
dependencies.maintenance: Actively maintained by Prisma with frequent patch releases.

dependencies.name: @testing-library/jest-dom
dependencies.necessity: Adds DOM assertions used by component tests.
dependencies.maintenance: Maintained by the Testing Library organisation.

dependencies.name: @testing-library/react
dependencies.necessity: Renders React components under test through accessible queries.
dependencies.maintenance: Maintained by the Testing Library organisation and tracks React releases.

dependencies.name: @types/node
dependencies.necessity: Supplies Node.js type declarations for strict type checking.

dependencies.name: @types/pg
dependencies.necessity: Supplies node-postgres type declarations for the database package.

dependencies.name: @types/react
dependencies.necessity: Supplies React type declarations for strict type checking.

dependencies.name: @types/react-dom
dependencies.necessity: Supplies React DOM type declarations for strict type checking.

dependencies.name: @vitejs/plugin-react
dependencies.necessity: Transforms React component sources for the Vitest component environment.

dependencies.name: concurrently
dependencies.necessity: Runs the web and worker development processes from a single command.
dependencies.notes: Development convenience only. Remove if the development entry point is ever simplified.

dependencies.name: dotenv
dependencies.necessity: Loads local database configuration for Prisma tooling; deployed environments use the platform secret manager instead.
dependencies.maintenance: Long-lived, widely used and actively released.

dependencies.name: eslint
dependencies.necessity: Enforces the repository lint gate.
dependencies.maintenance: Actively maintained with a published support policy.

dependencies.name: jsdom
dependencies.necessity: Provides the DOM environment for component tests.

dependencies.name: next
dependencies.necessity: The application framework for the internal web surface, including the standalone runtime output used by the container image.
dependencies.maintenance: Actively maintained by Vercel with a published security process.

dependencies.name: next-auth
dependencies.necessity: Implements the Google Workspace OIDC sign-in and server-side session handling required by the access capability.
dependencies.maintenance: Actively developed; the v5 line is still prerelease and carries an approved, expiring exception.
dependencies.notes: Prerelease risk is tracked as exception dependency-prerelease-next-auth.

dependencies.name: pg
dependencies.necessity: PostgreSQL driver shared by the Prisma adapter and the queue.

dependencies.name: pg-boss
dependencies.necessity: Provides the PostgreSQL-backed job queue that avoids operating a separate Redis service.
dependencies.maintenance: Actively maintained with a documented schema migration path.

dependencies.name: prettier
dependencies.necessity: Enforces the repository formatting gate.

dependencies.name: prisma
dependencies.necessity: Generates the client and applies, validates and drift-checks migrations. Not present in runtime images.

dependencies.name: react
dependencies.necessity: The rendering library required by Next.js.
dependencies.maintenance: Actively maintained by the React team.

dependencies.name: react-dom
dependencies.necessity: The DOM renderer required by Next.js.

dependencies.name: server-only
dependencies.necessity: Fails the build when server-only modules are imported into client bundles, protecting the credential and authorisation boundary.
dependencies.maintenance: Tiny, stable marker package published by the React team.

dependencies.name: tsx
dependencies.necessity: Executes TypeScript tooling scripts, including the security checks and the database seed.

dependencies.name: typescript
dependencies.necessity: Compiles every workspace and enforces the strict type gate.

dependencies.name: typescript-eslint
dependencies.necessity: Supplies the TypeScript parser and type-aware lint rules.
dependencies.maintenance: Actively maintained and tracks TypeScript releases.

dependencies.name: uuid
dependencies.necessity: Generates the opaque v7 identifiers used for workspace-scoped records and correlation IDs.

dependencies.name: vitest
dependencies.necessity: Runs the unit, component and database integration suites.

dependencies.name: zod
dependencies.necessity: Defines the startup configuration schema and the immutable analysis and strategy contracts.
